summary: Elong Power Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on August 27, 2026. Shareholders ratified a 45-for-1 share consolidation effective August 10, 2026, adopted amended articles, and amended a notice provision. The consolidation reduced authorized shares from 18.75 billion to 416,666,666, with par value adjusted from $0.0128 to $0.576. Quorum was 51.049% of voting power. All proposals passed with support from Class A and Class B shareholders. This corporate governance action is not a special situation; it is a routine charter and capital structure housekeeping matter.
